name: tr-address-districts
title: Districts of Türkiye
description: The 973 districts (ilçe) of Türkiye by province: the 922 named districts plus the central district (Merkez) of the 51 provinces that have one. Each district carries its TÜİK district code; approximate coordinates are given where an open source has them.

sources.title: Türkiye Mülki İdare Bölümleri Envanteri (T.C. İçişleri Bakanlığı): district names per province
GeoNames, TR.zip, feature code ADM2: latitude and longitude, and names that differ from the Ministry's (CC BY 4.0)

TÜİK Veri Portalı, İl ve İlçelere Göre İl/İlçe Merkezi, Belde/Köy Nüfusu (DF_ADNKS_T22 1.1, ADNKS 2025): district codes from code list CL_IBBS 1.2, retrieved 2026-11-05. Reuse permitted with attribution (TÜİK Yasal Uyarı).
Defterdarlık ve Vergi Daireleri Listesi (Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı), dated 2026-06-18, via tr-tax-tax-offices: district spellings that differ from the Ministry's

fields.name: province_code
fields.description: Two-digit province code. References code in tr-address-provinces.

fields.name: name
fields.description: District name in Turkish. Merkez is the central district of a province whose central district has no name of its own.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Approximate latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), from GeoNames. Empty when no match was found; always empty for Merkez.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Approximate longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), from GeoNames. Empty when no match was found; always empty for Merkez.

fields.name: tuik_code
fields.description: Four-digit district code assigned by TÜİK (code list CL_IBBS 1.2, as used in ADNKS statistics). Not derived from the province code.

fields.name: alternate_names
fields.description: Other spellings or names of the district found in the sources of this repository, separated by semicolons: the spelling used in the GİB tax office list (see tr-tax-tax-offices) and the GeoNames name. Empty when every source uses name. Use it to match records from those sources; name remains the official form.
